proof_summary: Assuming the claimed recurrence forces every relevant pair of consecutive terms to be coprime, while the shifted terms \(a_n+1\) obey a Fibonacci recurrence. Matrix exponentiation modulo \(195318521017\) shows that at offset \(249580073233\) two consecutive shifted terms are both \(1\), so the modulus divides both original terms, contradicting their gcd being \(1\).
